# IImage.Recolored method

A copy of the image turned to the hue of *color*, with its saturation and brightness scaled by that color's, so its shading stays. A pure color such as (0, 255, 0) only changes the hue. Grays stay gray.

```csharp
public IImage Recolored(Color color)
```

| parameter | description |
| --- | --- |
| color | Its alpha is ignored. |

## Return Value

The same object for the same image and color.
